summary: Banca Generali S.p.A. is an Italian private bank headquartered in Milan, Italy, specializing in wealth management and financial planning. The bank provides investment solutions, asset management, and insurance products to high-net-worth individuals and families. Banca Generali operates through a network of financial advisors and focuses on personalized financial services.
